title: Household Air Pollution & COPD
subtitle: Forecasting Burden. Optimising Intervention. Planning for 2040.

kpis.label: Real Budget Cap (50% Base)
kpis.detail: 50% of $11,971.5M 2025 HH LPG fiscal gap; Scenario A saturates at $3,097.3M

kpis.label: MDP Adaptive Policy (λ=116)
kpis.detail: 127.5k mean averted at $600.4M vs. 40.0% viol. for GA matched

kpis.label: Real Data & Parameters
kpis.detail: GBD 2023 + 1,585 WHO/DHS records + REAL_V1_2024USD + 18 sensitivity runs

objectives.title: Historical Trends (1990–2023)
objectives.summary: All five South Asian countries saw steep DALY ASR declines (Bhutan −94.2%, India −56.4%, Pakistan −44.0%, Nepal −40.0%, Bangladesh −32.2%), yet population ageing raised absolute DALY counts in India (+24.8% to 6.96M) and Nepal (+75.7% to 254.0k).

objectives.title: Forecasting to 2040
objectives.summary: B-12 multi-horizon CV fixes ETS (0 failures): fixed ETS (47.73/48.78 MAE; +53.9%/+52.8% skill) and ARIMA (49.33; +52.3% skill) lead short-term accuracy, while smooth Log-OLS (4-unit CV MAE 102.34 vs. 151.00 for HistGBDT; slope −2.1933 ± 0.2557 SE) replaces HistGBDT as the Stage 3 counterfactual surrogate.

objectives.title: Multi-Objective Optimisation
objectives.summary: 5-seed NSGA-II discovers 251 feasible Scenario A Pareto plans (combined HV 2.7965e+10), beating all three heuristic/random baselines. Knee saves 311.7k DALYs ($1,695.9M); DALY-min (=Equity-min) saves 453.5k DALYs ($3,097.3M) and lowers WHO-reconciled equity gap from 31.41 to 24.91/100k.

objectives.title: Sequential Adaptive Planning
objectives.summary: Recalibrated Finite-Horizon MDP (λ=116.0, 22,136 states) achieves 0.0% constraint violations across 1,000 uptake-shock rollouts ($600.4M mean cost, 127.5k averted), whereas open-loop GA achieves higher mean scalarized value (90.7k vs. 46.7k) with 40.0% cap/ceiling overshoot under 1.25× shocks.

research_questions.question: How have HAP-attributable COPD deaths and DALYs changed in India, Nepal, and wider South Asia from 1990 to 2023 by sex?
research_questions.note: Answered using GBD 2023 + UN WPP 2024 + NFHS/Census rural-urban apportionment across 5 countries and 4 subnational units.

research_questions.question: Which forecasting approach (statistical or ML) projects attributable burden to 2040 most reliably on held-out rolling windows?
research_questions.note: Answered via B-12 multi-horizon CV (fixed ETS 47.73 MAE / +53.9% skill vs ARIMA 49.33; smooth Log-OLS surrogate −2.1933 ± 0.2557 replacing HistGBDT + 500 draws).

research_questions.question: Under a real 50% fiscal clean-cooking budget ($5,985.73M), which allocation minimises projected 2040 DALYs vs. cost and urban–rural equity?
research_questions.note: Answered via 5-seed NSGA-II (251 Pareto plans), 500-draw joint MC re-evaluation, and 8-factor sensitivity (Scenario A vs. B1/B2 & Alt B opex).

research_questions.question: How does an adaptive MDP policy compare against open-loop GA schedules, HTN decomposition, and classical PDDL planning?
research_questions.note: Answered via 1,000 CRN rollouts under ±uptake shocks, showing MDP's 0.0% violation robustness vs. 40.0% (GA) and 26.9% (PDDL).
